description: Production TOPT ticks 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-13 (22:15 UTC), read with a read-only session (default_transaction_read_only=on) on 2026-10-20 for #1443. Each figure carries the observation id and the normalized payload sha256 of the stored row it was read from. 'published' is the stored mart.topt_core_results row; it is null on the ticks the plausibility gate refused (2026-10-09 to 2026-10-12), which materialized nothing. Those ticks keep only Micron's inputs, the issuer they were refused for. 'second_origin' is the corroborating financial-fact observation of the same run, revenue and gross profit by period end from 2024 on.
